artists.name: Omar Geles
artists.bio: Colombian vallenato singer and composer, renowned for his satirical and humorous songs that critique social issues with witty wordplay.

artists.name: Ivan Villazon y Saul Lallemand
artists.bio: Legendary vallenato duo from Colombia's Caribbean coast, known for their energetic performances and romantic ballads.

artists.name: Diomedes Díaz
artists.bio: The 'King of Vallenato', an iconic figure in Colombian music whose innovative accordion work shaped modern vallenato.

artists.name: Tomas Alfonso Zuleta & Nicolas Elias Mendoza
artists.bio: Classic vallenato composers and performers who captured the spirit of Caribbean celebration in their music.

artists.name: Carlos Vives
artists.bio: Contemporary Colombian artist blending traditional vallenato with modern sounds, bringing Colombian music to international audiences.

artists.name: El Binomio de Oro
artists.bio: Iconic Colombian musical duo pioneering the modernization of vallenato, setting standards for the genre.

artists.name: Los Corraleros de Majagual
artists.bio: Traditional Colombian cumbia group from Sucre, preserving the ancestral rhythms and cultural heritage of Caribbean music.

artists.name: Andrés Landero
artists.bio: Master of the accordion and traditional cumbia rhythms, instrumental in defining the sound of Colombian folk music.

artists.name: Calixto Ochoa
artists.bio: Renowned vallenato composer and performer whose poetic storytelling captures the essence of Colombian identity.
